status: source review, four-arm ablation and observed-feature prototype complete; bauble unresolved

sourceReview.scope: Sparse development diagnostic on the original collage. No points supplied to the classifier or fitter; not dense colour or cutting ground truth.

review.exclusionReason: Blurred frame ends, possible paper/background mixtures on the lower outline, and the narrow right-hand connection do not support confident paper identity. No classifier scores used in this exclusion.
review.limitation: Two selected upper-right frame pixels do not certify the entire frame or its physical routing.

assessment.meaning: Outline support and image bounds are diagnostics, not verified corners or known cutting paths.

crop.visualObservation: The automatic top corner is above the visible cleft, and the proposed lower-right side extends beyond the visible paper edge into background. The tip is 27.3 pixels below the photograph. This is an unsupported proposal, not a verified overlap square.
crop.qualification: No exact replacement corners or physical cutting paths have been established.

findings: All thirteen confidently reviewed source-paper points are correct in both saved classifications and both exported fits. These samples therefore do not support attributing the regression to colour classification at those locations.

Three classified regions have zero retention in the new export; they map to the ambiguous lower-right paper/background boundary. This proves a mismatch with the classified target, not that every lost fragment is a genuine design feature.
The old fit selected 5+4 cuts; the observed-only fit selected 4+4. Both considered 22 count/phase hypotheses and failed the source-feature checks.
Removing outside-image padding does not remove photographed background accidentally included by an inaccurate crop.

The four-arm experiment is complete. Classification and observation weights interact: new classification improves the whole-square arm, but its observed-only arm is worse. A fixed time budget and cold first run limit causal attribution.

controlledExperiment.scope: Same original photograph and automatic crop. Four fresh binary fits; no saved curves supplied. Separate classification from missing-source weights, then cross-score every export on both observed classifications.
controlledExperiment.visualReview: All four outputs retain the central disc but have broken border pieces and distorted frame regions. New-whole and old-observed are closer to their classified target than new-observed. None is a successful complete reconstruction.
controlledExperiment.qualification: Each arm starts from fresh grids, but the old-whole arm ran cold and differs from its earlier saved baseline. All are time-limited; this is not a fixed-work or randomized replicated causal estimate.

lowerEdgeProbe.scope: Offline diagnostic: alternate RANSAC lower-line hypotheses from the same source segmentation; no template error or cutting solution used. All complete-outline support checks retained.
lowerEdgeProbe.finding: The retained segmentation samples cover only sixteen adjacent source rows. Re-ranking the same samples yields no distinct useful alternative; the flexible-cap fit still extrapolates its tip outside the photo. Earlier broader sampling/colour experiments are preserved in remaining-photo-failures.md and crop-edge-evidence.md; this probe does not supersede them.

observedFeaturePrototype.scope: Fresh ten-second binary fits on the exact three saved classified masks and observation regions. Candidate enables feature proposals on observation-only weights; no saved templates supplied.
observedFeaturePrototype.change: Enable early feature proposals for observation-only weights; compose all feature emphasis with original weights and score proposals against the original observed objective. The source masks, crops, missing-pixel support, physical rules and error limits stay fixed.
observedFeaturePrototype.finding: The candidate recovers the bauble classified regions and lowers error from 4.38% to 2.06%, but has a 1.341 mm self-clearance return below the required 1.5 mm, uncertain paper support, and no complete success. Ribbons remain identical by mask error; flower changes by three sampled pixels. A lower mask score cannot justify shipping invalid templates.
observedFeaturePrototype.visualReview: Bauble retains additional right-hand fragments but has visible narrow slivers and still does not establish a faithful frame. Ribbons and flower retain their main motifs. All three targets are estimated masks, not cutting ground truth.

nextWork: The observed-only fitter needs useful feature proposals without exhausting the budget on an invalid route, while the cropper needs paper/background evidence beyond its current short lower-edge samples. Neither lowering physical tolerances nor treating every ambiguous border fragment as genuine artwork is justified.
